items.q: I don't think you'll ever hear another baritone player as great as Carney with Duke.

In our time, in our lifetime, I don't think you'll ever hear another baritone player as great as Carney with Duke.
Like in Louie -- (inaudible) with Louie, there will never be another Louie Armstrong, or a Duke Ellington. The type of things that Duke would do to give to the world.
